title: driftkings
author: driftkings
changelog: NOTICE: the settings panel is still under construction. Layouts and live previews may contain errors and have not completed visual in-game acceptance. A visible localized notice is included in the panel.

Correct nested scrolling, marker text dimensions, shadows, destroyed-state samples, font entities and preview refresh. The carousel preview reads bounded inventory/dossier snapshots and the selected rating palette, with labeled examples when live data is unavailable.

Target Wargaming World of Tanks 2.4.1.1 on EU, NA and ASIA, using the EU 2.4.1.5504 source/SWC reference and a reviewed native vehicle-marker patch. EU/NA Gameface patch inputs were verified against the installed clients.

CONFIGURATION UPGRADE: when moving from the pre-0.1.3 configuration layout, back up personal images and sounds, remove the old mods/configs/driftkings folder and configure the mod again. Legacy colour prefixes and old layouts are not imported automatically.

Add integrated vehicle markers with independent ally/enemy, alive/destroyed and normal/ALT layouts; configure text, ratings, health bars, icons, distance and floating damage through the five marker documents.

Ship the redesigned Gameface settings panel with module icons, collapsible categories, option details, change review and minimap/HUD/carousel/rich-text previews. Retain the original spectrum colour picker, HEX presets and alpha handling.

Preserve configured font names, Unicode characters and HTML entities. Include the original symbol-font resources with their aliases and credits in Flash and Gameface, while preserving native FieldFont/TitleFont lookup.
Use #RRGGBB for colour settings and templates across Python, ActionScript and Gameface; retain shared numeric conversion helpers at native API boundaries.
Correct account/vehicle WN8 sources and weights, add WNX and the Tomato.gg palette, and support shared rating colours in battle text, results and the vehicle carousel.

Refresh statistics tables every 24 hours through bounded background downloads and persistent caches. Apply refreshed data in the lobby, retain valid data on failures and reject corrupt cache/calibration inputs.
Improve minimap artillery aim, hull-direction lines, map-size captions and colourblind markers; apply reticle-size correction consistently to artillery trajectory and dispersion rendering.

Move clock fields into General settings and adopt the author's EU defaults for panel positions, carousel, minimap and markers. The settings window starts at 140% scale and 94% opacity; current-layout personal settings remain authoritative.
Centralize Python Gameface and Flash adapters under battle/lobby, keep the shared UI catalogue authoritative and remove unused legacy hooks, rating adapters and generated build/authoring caches.
Provide 18 centralized language catalogues, including 243 panel labels, and regression coverage that opens all 35 real settings pages and 1104 controls.

Package the Windows installer, modpack/defaults archives, dependencies, SHA-256 inventory and Ed25519-signed updater manifest. Automated and native-package validation passed; visual in-game acceptance of the latest UI/font changes was not performed during this release preparation.
